description: PROTOTYPE (QA #42, A5). Qwen Code (>=0.24) hooks for the Crosstalk bus. Merge the `hooks` object into ~/.qwen/settings.json on an ENROLLED machine and replace <plugin-src> with the installed plugin's src dir. Same protocol as Claude Code hooks: stdin JSON with session_id, exit 2 blocks. `timeout` is in SECONDS. User-level hooks need no trust prompt but are read only at session start. The receive bridge needs the session to run under `qwen serve` (QWEN_SERVE_URL, default http://127.0.0.1:4170). SECURITY: bus text reaches an agent that can run tools. The enforceable boundary is the run_shell_command PreToolUse hook below (cc-qwen-shell-gate.mjs: it parses the command; only ONE clean bus-client command is allowed, default mode bus-only). The bridge refuses to start (ensure exit 3) when permissions.allow contains "*" / an unscoped shell rule, an approvalMode is yolo, or this shell gate is not wired. No permissions.allow entry is needed for the bus client: the hook returns an explicit allow.
